app.title: Show HN: I simulated closing the Strait of Hormuz on real oil trade data
app.author: eliotho
app.description: Simulates the impact of a Hormuz oil chokepoint closure on global oil flows using data from the International Maritime Organization (IMO)
proposed_tests: Run the simulation with different chokepoint percentages
Compare simulation results against historical closure data
Analyze the impact on oil prices during closure
